topic: AI agents built a SaaS in 10 minutes — are junior devs cooked?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Yo Alex! AI agents built a full SaaS app in ten minutes!

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Are junior devs totally cooked now?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Relax Leo! Typing syntax is dead, systems thinking is not.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Wait, what does that even mean?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: AI spits boilerplate, but can't architect production databases!

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Bro, so what should we learn in 2026?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Vector DBs, local LLMs, and MCP tool calling.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: I put the full roadmap plus templates in the bio link!

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: So I can just prompt my way to placements?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Sure, and I can microwave my way to Michelin star!
